Legacy checkpoint fixtures

legacy_states.zip contains nine synthetic V3 stories, CFX86SAVE2 saves, and a
manifest of reference continuations. It contains no commercial game data.

The hand-assembled stories come from the probe_story cases in Fernz's
MIT-licensed tests/test_state_bridge.py at commit
e44e7f51d84a58941915349cbb0b4326d153cdb3 (Copyright 2026 Adam Fourney).
They exercise nested frames, local/global/stack input operands, large return
addresses, counting/affine/host-seeded RNG modes, and returns to parent/root
contexts.

Captured on little-endian Linux using Jericho 3.3.1's public reset, step,
get_state, and set_state methods, with host seed 42. The files were written by
Cabin Fever's original SaveStore at commit b4933c8. All snapshots are at line
input boundaries; parent_frame and root_frame follow one and two look commands,
respectively, and the other cases are captured immediately after reset.

The manifest records the remaining look commands through termination. Before
continuing an ordinary-mode checkpoint, the reference's public set_state was
used to select RNG state (42, 0, 0), matching Cabin Fever's reseeding-on-reload
policy. Counting-mode checkpoints retain their saved RNG unchanged. Generated
stories print tagged numeric results; reference-only status-line presentation
is excluded from comparison. CI runs the importer and continuation with Fernz
only, with no Jericho or Fernz source-checkout dependency.

The copied converter in server/_state_bridge.py includes the upstream MIT
license and retains the reverse conversion for round-trip validation.
